input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including user. The platform provides capabilities for json handler method return value handler, user. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with codeless method factory functionality, so that I can accomplish my codeless method factory-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with codeless proxy functionality, so that I can accomplish my codeless proxy-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with example functionality, so that I can accomplish my example-related tasks.
